listings.title: X-Display for Beyblade X
listings.description:
X-Display - Customizable LED Launcher Accessory

Elevate your Beyblade X battles with the X-Display, a sleek LED accessory designed to mount seamlessly on top of your winder or string launcher. Featuring a vibrant 11x48 pixel LED screen loaded with dynamic pre-installed animations like flames, arrows, and more, this add-on brings electrifying style to your tournaments.

Make it your own with two customizable text frames—add your name, a battle motto, or any phrase you choose. Built for Beyblade X enthusiasts, this durable accessory combines bold flair with reliable performance, ensuring your launcher shines in every spin.

Key Features:
-Vibrant LED screen with pre-loaded animations (flames, arrows, and more)
-Two customizable text frames for names or phrases
-Easy-to-mount design for Beyblade X winder or string launcher
-Durable construction for tournament-ready performance

Ready to light up the arena? Enter your custom text at checkout and grab your X-Display today!
listings.dimensions_or_compatibility: 11x48 pixel LED screen; mounts on top of winder or string launcher

listings.title: Ratchet Balancing Tool for BeybladeX
listings.description:
Ratchet Balancing Tool - Optimize Your Beyblade X Combos

Maximize your Beyblade X performance with the Ratchet Balancing Tool, designed to fine-tune both stamina and aggressive combos. This precision tool allows you to optimize stamina setups for longer spins or create a larger offset for harder-hitting aggressive combos, giving you the edge in any battle.
Through extensive testing, we've found this tool excels in stamina matchups, often making the critical difference in spin-out scenarios. Crafted for Beyblade X enthusiasts, it’s a must-have for players looking to elevate their game with precision and strategy.
Key Features:

-Optimizes stamina combos for extended spin times
-Enhances aggressive combos with larger offset for harder hits
-Proven effective in stamina matchups through rigorous testing
-Durable and easy-to-use design for all skill levels

Ready to dominate the arena? Add the Ratchet Balancing Tool to your collection today!

listings.title: Digital Download X-Grip for Beyblade X
listings.description:
This file is provided for non-commercial, personal use only and is not to be redistributed

This Zip Includes:
-Bambulab Optomized printing file(s)
>A1/P1S/X1C/H2D
This file also includes:
-Text Printing Instructions
-Standard Grip & Left Handed Grip
>Bot Body.obj
>Bot Body Accents.obj
>Top Body.obj
>Top Body Accents.obj
>Grip.obj
>Peg.STL
>Lock.obj
The file Does require Glue to assemble: (any crazy glue will work)
My recommendation:
InstantBond (Adhesive) -This Adhesive comes with a setting agent, I prefer to let the glue dry on its own so you can slide the part into position and let it set for about 15minutes.
listings.dimensions_or_compatibility: Bambu Lab optimized print files, compatible with A1/P1S/X1C/H2D printers; includes Standard Grip and Left Handed Grip STL/OBJ files; requires glue to assemble (non-commercial, personal use only, not for redistribution)

listings.title: FoundersX BeybladeX Deck Case: White, 3on3 Edition
listings.description:
FoundersX 3on3 Deck Case – Edition [White]

Description:
Introducing the FoundersX Deck Case – the ultimate deck case crafted to celebrate the launch of R3D! Engineered for convenience, style, and strategy, this case takes your battling experience to the next level. This case marks the epic kickoff of your new go-to accessory store for X-series spinning tops.

Exclusivity:
This box is a rare, limited-time treasure that won’t last long. Once it’s gone from the store, the Gold and Silver styles are retired forever. The Founders Edition Meteorite stays in the shop for five months, until September 2025, or until 300 units per style are sold—whichever comes first—then makes way for a new limited edition series. These future releases will bring fresh, game-inspired themes, swapping out every three months or after hitting 300 units sold.

Features:

Exclusive Redesign: A completely refreshed exterior and interior, packed with unique details crafted to honor R3D’s grand opening.

Wrist Lanyard: Carry your deck effortlessly wherever the battle takes you.

Peek-Proof Lid: Hide your picks in style! The clever lid doubles as a shield to keep your opponent guessing.

Secure Design: Equipped with a locking lid and a sleek magnetic clasp for peace of mind.

Spacious Fit: From your shortest setup to your tallest combo, the ArmoryX accommodates all official X-series spinning top combinations with room to spare.

Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned veteran, the FoundersX Deck Case is your perfect companion for organizing, protecting, and showcasing your X-series spinning top collection. ELEVATE THE GAME – grab yours before it’s gone in September 2025!
listings.description_note: Description text references a September 2025 sunset date for this limited edition; site copy appears not to have been updated since (scrape date is Sept 2026). Recorded verbatim.
listings.dimensions_or_compatibility: Accommodates all official X-series spinning top combinations, from shortest setup to tallest combo
